name: Slice 2: Slim viewport, view options in header menus
body:
# Slice 2: slim viewport

The main toolbar keeps file, undo and redo, tools, snapping, play. The camera preset, grid, wireframe, colliders, markers,
hidden entities and statistics leave it for a header on the viewport with three drop-down menus (view, show, camera
speed and snapping), and the long controls hint becomes a short one with a key to open the full list.
